# Training Settings {#sec-appendix-training}

| Setting | Value |
|:--------------|:----------------------|
| Training library | LibMTL, with its default settings where none is listed here |
| Update method | Adam |
| Weight decay | 1 × 10^−5^ |
| Learning rates tried | 1, 3, 5, and 8 × 10^−5^ |
| Learning rate during a run | Held constant |
| Limit on gradient size | None, except a maximum of 1.0 for Nash-MTL |
| Epochs | 10, without early stopping |
| Version of the model kept from a run | The epoch with the highest validation score |
| Validation score | Mean of the two F1-scores, or the F1-score of a single-task model |
| Batch size | 8 |
| Number format | 32-bit numbers |
| Maximum length of a post | 128 tokens, with longer posts cut off |
| Trained layers | All except the embedding layer of the encoder |
| Task weights tried for linear scalarization | 0.1 to 0.9 in steps of 0.1 for humanitarian classification, and one minus that value for NER |
| Random seed of the tuning runs | 0 |
| Random seeds of the main runs and the learning curve | 1 to 5 |
| Classification head | Joins the output for the first token with the mean output over all tokens |
| NER head | Assigns each word one of 21 BIO labels through its first token |
| Loss of each task | Cross-entropy |
| GradNorm α and CAGrad c | 1.5 and 0.4 |

: Training Settings of All Models {#tbl-training-settings tbl-colwidths="[35,65]"}

| Optimizer | Implementation | Where the Task Gradients Are Taken |
|:------------------|:--------------|:------------------------------|
| Equal weighting | LibMTL | Not used |
| Linear scalarization | Written for this study | Not used. The task weights are tuned |
| Random loss weighting | LibMTL | Not used |
| Uncertainty weighting | LibMTL | Not used |
| DWA | LibMTL | Not used |
| GradNorm | LibMTL, changed so that the encoder is also trained in the first epoch | Output of the encoder |
| MGDA | LibMTL | Output of the encoder |
| GradDrop | LibMTL | Output of the encoder |
| IMTL | LibMTL | Output of the encoder |
| PCGrad | LibMTL | All trained parameters of the encoder |
| GradVac | LibMTL | All trained parameters of the encoder |
| CAGrad | LibMTL | All trained parameters of the encoder |
| Nash-MTL | LibMTL | All trained parameters of the encoder |
